Definition: to fondle; by implication, to love, especially to compassionate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to love, love deeply, have mercy, be compassionate, have tender affection, have compassion; 1a) (Qal) to love; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to have compassion, be compassionate; 1b1a) of God, man; 1c) (Pual) to be shown compassion, be compassionate
